title: The sprint skill's plan step asks every leak-scan or redaction exemption for a check that plants a real-secret-shaped value beside it
goal: The plan step of .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md says an item that adds an exemption to the leak scan or to redact carries one check per exemption that plants a secret-shaped value (built at run time) the exemption must still flag, so a fix like the closed-value path exemption of BG-fwqcimiv cannot pass its own positive layouts while opening a hole (SP-osevumx6 review: BG-vqszwskv, BG-fjptk52z)

run:
import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('## start',1)[0].lower()
miss=[w for w in ['exemption', 'must still flag'] if w not in s]
sys.exit('not yet: plan section lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
